readme: # Example Module Demo A minimal [KernelSU](https://kernelsu.org) module that shows how to publish a module to the [KernelSU Modules](https://modules.kernelsu.org). It installs nothing and does nothing on the device — copy this repository as a starting point for your own module. ## Layout | Path | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `module/` | The module itself; its **contents** become the root of the release ZIP | | `module/module.prop` | id, version and **versionCode** — the only source of version information | | `module.yaml` | KernelSU Modules display metadata (name, summary, icon, tags, …) | | `README.md` | This page — also the module's detail page, referenced from `module.yaml` | | `assets/icon.png` | Icon (generated by `node scripts/gen-icon.mjs`) | | `.github/workflows/release.yml` | Publishes an immutable release when a `v*` tag is pushed | ## Releasing a new version 1. Enable **Settings → General → Releases → Enable release immutability** (once). 2. Bump `version` and `versionCode` in `module/module.prop` (versionCode must increase). 3. Commit, then tag and push: ```sh git tag v1.0.1 && git push origin v1.0.1 ``` 4. The workflow zips `module/`, prechecks it with the KernelSU Modules validator and publishes `example_module_demo--.zip` as an immutable release. Tags containing `-` (e.g. `v1.1.0-rc1`) are published as prereleases. KernelSU Modules picks up the release automatically within minutes. See the [developer documentation](https://developers.kernelsu.org/docs/) for details. ## License [MIT](LICENSE)
readmeHTML:
Example Module Demo

A minimal KernelSU module that shows how to publish a module to the

KernelSU Modules. It installs nothing and does nothing on

the device — copy this repository as a starting point for your own module.

Layout

| Path | Purpose |

| --- | --- |

| module/ | The module itself; its contents become the root of the release ZIP |

| module/module.prop | id, version and versionCode — the only source of version information |

| module.yaml | KernelSU Modules display metadata (name, summary, icon, tags, …) |

| README.md | This page — also the module's detail page, referenced from module.yaml |

| assets/icon.png | Icon (generated by node scripts/gen-icon.mjs) |

| .github/workflows/release.yml | Publishes an immutable release when a v* tag is pushed |

Releasing a new version

  • Enable **Settings → General → Releases → Enable release immutability** (once).
  • Bump `version` and `versionCode` in `module/module.prop` (versionCode must increase).
  • Commit, then tag and push:

    • ```sh

    git tag v1.0.1 && git push origin v1.0.1

    ```

  • The workflow zips `module/`, prechecks it with the KernelSU Modules validator and publishes

    • example_module_demo--.zip as an immutable release.

    Tags containing - (e.g. v1.1.0-rc1) are published as prereleases.

    KernelSU Modules picks up the release automatically within minutes. See the

    developer documentation for details.

    License

    MIT
